d: A very pleasant part of petiola and uninhabited islet overlooking the sea, adorned distinctly by the nature of strange plants, capricious caves and flowery bushes. Big rock much ahead from the right side, on which we read an inscription not finished in European characters. Constance, dressed in a whim of skins, fronds and flowers, with elsa and part of sword worn to the hand, in the act of finishing the imperfect inscription.
Silvia hasty and cheerful, and said.
Gernando, Enrico in Indian paliscreen dress, and Silvia in the background.
Henry, and Silvia on the side.
Henry before the left, Silvia back on the same side, moving towards the right without seeing it.
Silvia from the right and sayings; then Gernando from the same side.
